title: Chapter 395 Farewell To The Emperor
content:
Chapter 395 Farewell To The Emperor

At this moment, the Human Emperor had a faint smile on his face, and looked at the hall with deep eyes, standing calmly in a snow robe.

"I've finally waited for you."

The Human Emperor said with a smile, with a little excitement in his noble voice.

"wait for me?"

Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows slightly and his voice was suspicious.

He was very sure that it was the first time he had met the Human Emperor.

But now, the first thing the Human Emperor said was that he finally waited for him.

Not only Lu Daosheng was confused, but the other human masters in the palace were even more confused.

At this time, the Human Emperor slowly stood up, and the wide dragon robe naturally hung on the ground, and a faint, but deep-seated noble aura unconsciously emitted.

"Sir, I know you may have a lot of doubts now, but I don't have much time left."

The Human Emperor's words immediately shocked the audience and caused a huge wave.

All the powerful humans present looked shocked and unbelievable.

They spoke one after another, their tone of anxiety, trying to ask something.

But the Human Emperor stretched out his hands and pressed against everyone.

In an instant, everyone's words came to their mouths and swallowed them again.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the Human Emperor.

The two of them looked at each other and they both knew what the other person meant.

The next moment, the two of them moved and disappeared into the hall, leaving behind powerful humans with different expressions in the hall.

The boundary of the universe, looking at the constantly shattering world in front of you, a trace of sadness surged in the eyes of the Human Emperor.

"Sir, you can see that I'm almost out of reach."

Hearing the words of the Human Emperor, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

From the moment he entered the hall, he felt the indelible scars in the human emperor's body.

Those scars are like a world that is about to collapse now.

Now, it is no exaggeration to say that the Human Emperor has been insisting on it.

Because once the boundaries of the universe are gone, the world will basically not last long.

"So, have you been waiting for me for so long?"

The Human Emperor nodded, "Sir, I believe you can definitely solve this problem."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's brain was running rapidly.

My origin is indeed not that simple.

Maybe, I really have a very powerful identity.

But now, it is imperative to understand what is happening now.

The Human Emperor is indeed at the end of his strength. It can be called a miracle to be able to persevere until now.

But after all, he is the Human Emperor, so it is normal for him to create miracles.

"Then what are you planning now? Rest and rest, just ignore it?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the Human Emperor and asked.

The Human Emperor is indeed not able to do it now. Since he has come and has the ability, he will naturally not ignore it.

But who knew that the Human Emperor shook his head slowly.

"Sir, stopping here is just a helpless move, at most it will only delay the collapse of the world."

"If the origin of the world can be solved, then all problems will not be problems."

The words of the Human Emperor came into Lu Daosheng's ears, which immediately made Lu Daosheng fall into deep thought.

Solve the origin of the world.

This is simple, but there is no clue at all.

"Sir, the student believes in you."

The Human Emperor blinked and chuckled.

student?

This self-proclaimed made Lu Daosheng slightly stunned. He stared at the Human Emperor and opened his mouth to speak.

But at this time, the Human Emperor slowly turned around and looked at the boundary of the universe.

There, the undescribable power is constantly breaking down the world into a darkness.

"This will be my last move."

The Emperor of Humans spoke lightly and slowly flew forward.

At the same time, the entire universe's boundary vibrates.

In countless ancient houses, countless powerful people with powerful aura appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

They have different forms, but at this moment, they are all looking at the Human Emperor with tears in their eyes.

"We wait, respectfully give it to the Emperor!"

"Give me a gift to the Emperor!"

The grand sound shattered the sky and resounded across the boundaries of the universe.

The human emperor's figure began to slowly dissipate.

A gentle and irresistible force began to gush out, and then slapped wildly towards the broken border.

In an instant, the entire universe boundary began to improve.

But at this moment, the creatures present had no sign of happiness, but instead burst into tears.

Because they knew that this was exchanged for the Human Emperor with his own life.

Seeing that the Human Emperor was about to dissipate, Lu Daosheng no longer cared about anything. He knew that the Human Emperor could no longer save him, so he had to ask loudly, "Human Emperor, tell me, who am I?"

As if he heard Lu Daosheng's call, the Human Emperor turned around and smiled at Lu Daosheng.

Nothing said.

The Human Emperor is gone.

It was strange that Lu Daosheng had only seen the Human Emperor for a short time, but when he saw the Human Emperor leave, he felt sad.

At this moment, the border still resounded with the roar of sending the Emperor to the Emperor.

There is no doubt that the Human Emperor has a very heavy weight in this universe boundary.

The Human Emperor is also the leader of the human race.

As long as the world is not destroyed, in the future, and even after endless years, the Human Emperor will leave an extremely strong mark in world history.

He is as bright as the sun, shining on the future generations of the human race.

At this moment, the great way roared and the heaven and earth trembled.

In order to resist the collapse of the world, countless powerful men died one after another on the road to resistance.

Even the Human Emperor of the Human Clan suffered irreversible injuries, let alone other strong people.

It is no exaggeration to say that the boundaries of the universe are experiencing separation of life and death every moment.

But this time, the sentient beings are in unprecedented sorrow.

That's the Human Emperor.

And the human race suffered a huge blow.

At this moment, almost all the powerful human race seemed to have lost their backbone and had no fighting spirit.

"Let me go, I will follow Lord Human Emperor to the death!"

Suddenly, there was movement in the crowd.

Several powerful humans were holding a nearly crazy human being, and persuaded him, "Brother Lin, don't do stupid things."

"The Lord Human Emperor is for us and for the whole world."

"Yes, I can't do these stupid things, which disappoints Lord Emperor."

The person who was blocked was named Lin Ziye. He was given the gift of the Human Emperor and then rose up all the way and became the top power in this world. Then, in order to repay the human Emperor's kindness, he came to the boundaries of the universe and contributed his own strength. .

Over the years, he has worked diligently and has been on the front line almost every time.

Now, when he saw the Human Emperor leaving, he was extremely sad and vowed to follow him to the death.

Lin Ziye turned a deaf ear to the persuasion of the people around him and tried his best to break free.

But at this moment, a gentle force emerged from the field.

Everyone became quiet in an instant.

I saw a man slowly walking from outside the crowd, wearing a snow robe and looking easy-going.

When everyone saw this person, they all shut their mouths.

They knew that Lu Daosheng had just communicated with the Human Emperor in private.

Although I don’t know what the two said, Lu Daosheng’s identity and strength are definitely not simple.
